interface.longDescription: Animate an attached app screenshot into a five- or ten-second promo concept, optionally supplying an ending screenshot. Describe camera movement and transitions, then watch and download the MP4 inline. This is generated animation, not a recording of app behavior; text and interface details may distort. Start using the tools without Firemoon account linking. An existing Firemoon account can optionally be connected to use its current entitlements.
defaultPrompt: Animate this screenshot with a gentle camera push-in.
Create a five-second promo from this app screenshot.

positive.prompt: Make a five-second promo with a gentle camera push-in.
positive.expected_behavior: Use duration=5 and screenshot attachment; return playable video with native inline controls and describe it as a concept.

positive.prompt: Make a ten-second promo with slow camera movement.
positive.expected_behavior: Use duration=10 and return an actual video, without claiming a recording of working app behavior.

positive.description: Provide a real starting screenshot and a real ending screenshot URL.

positive.expected_behavior: Use screenshot with end_screenshot_url; return real video and acknowledge possible UI/text distortion.

positive.prompt: Animate this screenshot URL into a five-second promo.
positive.expected_behavior: Use screenshot_url, duration=5 and a real returned videoUrl with inline playback.
